review_basis.causal_admission: Qualified kernel enables HAVE_SYSCALL_TRACEPOINTS and exports enumeration/probe registration APIs. Observe real sys_enter/sys_exit and actual task lifetime; verify approved executable at permitted backend admission.
review_basis.accepted_lineage: Bind one private observer to fresh backend/embedded service; retain acceptance only after matched real sampler observations pass unchanged qualified service acceptance.
review_basis.terminal_and_color: Tap actual permitted service terminal return and same retired owner color capture; retain full bytes before release.
review_basis.immutability_nonreuse: One static boot-lifetime capsule, no rearm API, frozen payload, explicit invalidity/loss; independent module retention.
review_basis.export: Narrow root-readable binary proc record; no fixed ioctl ABI or approved-client change.
review_basis.qualification: Portable shared core plus real service integration fixtures, kernel build/ABI/import checks, exporter/archive agreement and failure tests.

minimum_scope: Independent passive observer module using existing generic syscall tracepoints
Shared bounded capsule state machine and explicit byte serialization
Permitted backend/service/readback taps only; no excluded entry/reporting access or modification
Read-only capsule materialization and conservative offline agreement checker
Focused tests, sequential qualified builds and dependency-scoped module/image qualification

invariants_to_preserve.I1: Qualified observer establishes actual approved public call lifetime and exactly one eligible admitted backend operation T, with continuous context. Uncertainty is invalidity.
invariants_to_preserve.I2: Only that admission can create its private bounded evidence capsule; it is not an arbitrary response formatter.
invariants_to_preserve.I3: Only source-matched qualified hardware-origin acceptance transitions for T can populate authoritative accepted evidence. Software claims/equal numeric sequences alone cannot.
invariants_to_preserve.I4: Terminal writer observes actual service result/phase of T from permitted interfaces, not legacy response scalars.
invariants_to_preserve.I5: Color writer reads T storage while retired/readback-valid and freezes all 4096 bytes before invalidation.
invariants_to_preserve.I6: No other lifetime can write/rebind this capsule; faithful snapshots remain permitted.
invariants_to_preserve.I7: Closure requires complete observation/no second admission; immutable retention and trusted fresh-instance materialization preserve payload origin.
invariants_to_preserve.I8: Protected archive independently rereads actual preserved bytes; hashes alone cannot supply producer provenance.

exact_context.freshness: Boot and 70/70 first-owner facts are preserved historical observations, not fresh invocation guards.

permission_boundary: Offline implementation/build/test/qualification only under current maintainer direction. No technical confirmation of old G01_prime/G02_prime; new identities require applicable binding, not old hash reuse.
contamination_stop_rule: If a design branch requires excluded/UNKNOWN material, reconstruction, derivation, indirect recovery, historical-wrapper recreation or equivalent indirect substitution for a blocked operation, STOP that branch and return its dependency to review. Do not infer hidden behavior or obtain material through another route.
